cards.fpsTitle: Frames per second actually rendered (derived from the real interval between rendered frames).
cards.frameTitle: Real time between two frames = the true per-frame budget. This is what the user feels.
cards.gpuSpanTitle: REAL GPU time of the frame = last marker − first marker on the GPU timeline. This is the authoritative total, including GPU work located between the measured categories.
cards.sumTitle: Σ of per-category durations: gaps between ends of ordinary passes, explicit spans for Snapshot and Merge. The sum may differ slightly from the span because of smoothing and markers.

breakdown.instantHint: (scaled to the frame budget — grey = headroom/idle)
breakdown.instantAria: Instant breakdown of GPU time per pass
breakdown.avgAria: 30 s average breakdown of GPU time per pass

notice.title: Per-pass timing unavailable
notice.after: (common on mobile/Safari). The global metrics above remain valid. To isolate the cost of one pass without a barrier, use
notice.end: : loop the pass N times and divide the GPU time delta by N.

render.title: Render
render.cpuBeforeGpuTitle: CPU time before engine.render(): precise navigation, Vue propagation then Engine.update() preparation.
render.cpuDetailTitle: Breakdown of CPU time outside GPU passes: navigator / Vue models / Engine.update / WebGPU encoding and submission.
render.cadenceTitle: Raw interval of the last requestAnimationFrame callback, its smoothed average and the interval targeted by the pacer.

passHelp.merge: Merge of resolved+frozen into a third display then swap, without a preparatory copy. Runs only when a zoom stops.
passHelp.snapshot: Copy of the resolved display into the frozen snapshot used during the zoom.
passHelp.reproject: Pan by toroidal origin shift of the raw cache: only the exposed band is stamped.
passHelp.clear: Reset of the raw cache with sentinels, distinct from the pan shift.
passHelp.reseed: Selective re-seeding of the frontier for one anti-aliasing sample. Active only during AA accumulation.
passHelp.compute: Fused brush+mandelbrot+counting kernel (perturbation/BLA/jet…). This is the core of the cost.
passHelp.resolve: Temporary bilinear presentation of the exact pixels still incomplete.
passHelp.aaAccum: Colour pass accumulated into the (linear) AA buffer during accumulation.
passHelp.color: Direct colour pass to the screen, or linear bake of the final cache when a rotated view has just settled.
passHelp.present: Presentation of the AA accumulator, or bilinear reconstruction of the rotated colour cache, then sRGB conversion.
